I have written PL/pgSQL in 1 public repository, from 2026 to 2026.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [Data Atlas](@/work/data-atlas.md): Datasets, cadastre, transport, remote sensing and spatial analytics in one single-file, searchable page.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses PL/pgSQL: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links PL/pgSQL to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
